audience.programmeDescription: Theology and Religious Studies at VU Amsterdam examines religious traditions, beliefs, texts and practices and their place in society. The part-time Religion and Worldviews route combines comparative study of religions with philosophy, social science and research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related courses in myth, philosophy, art and heritage. VU brings these perspectives together through sustained study of religious traditions, interpretation of sacred texts and research on lived religion. The curriculum below shows how that study develops at VU.

curriculum.limitation: The recommended part-time schedule covers 180 EC over six calendar years. Teaching is mainly in Dutch in the first two academic stages and in English in the third stage of this route.

componentNotes.stage3-minor: 30 EC of approved study. Options include a minor, academic electives or a placement of up to 12 EC with 18 EC of coursework.
componentNotes.stage3-01: Entry requires 120 EC in the programme and completion of all first-year and first-semester second-year courses.
componentNotes.stage3-05: The required 6 EC thesis follows successful completion of the thesis preparation lab.
